forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies can lead to unresolvable imports and runtime errors

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Orphan modules are not used anywhere and can be removed

forbidden.name: no-deprecated-core
forbidden.comment: Avoid using deprecated Node.js core modules

forbidden.name: no-non-package-json
forbidden.comment: Don't allow dependencies that are not in package.json (except type-only imports)

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: Modules that cannot be resolved lead to runtime errors
